Class GameRenderer

java.lang.Object
game.ui.GameRenderer
public class GameRenderer extends Object
Handles the visual rendering of the game state onto the JavaFX Canvas. Responsible for caching images, drawing the grid environment, rendering machines and items, and displaying the placement hologram.
